sources.title: Managing Forms in Collect — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; sent/finalized edits feature explicitly introduced with Collect v2025.2.0 and Central v2025.1.4.
sources.locator: Sections ‘Finalizing drafts’, ‘Sending finalized forms’, ‘Sending previously-sent forms’, ‘Editing finalized or sent forms’; web lines 144–198 and linked version note.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary ODK documentation page; reviewed the local Draft/Ready to send/Sent behavior and its explicit version gate.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline or auto-send-disabled finalized forms appear in Ready to send; finalized forms are ordinarily not editable. `client_editable=true` is opt-in and, from Collect v2025.2.0/Central v2025.1.4, permits editing finalized/sent records still on-device. Manually queued edits must be sent in order. Central-edited records can no longer be edited from Collect. Edits use the original form version.
sources.applicability: Directly relevant Android survey behavior and corrections. The workflow is documented, not exercised here; confirm currently deployed app/server versions before relying on the feature.

sources.title: Metadata Scheme — ODK Docs / OpenRosa
sources.version_or_commit: Living OpenRosa/XForms metadata documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; no product build pinned on the page.
sources.locator: ‘Form Identity’, ‘Version’, ‘Completed Form Metadata’, ‘Fields’, and ‘ID field formatting’; web lines 121–146 and 177–206.
sources.observed_operation: Opened and read metadata definitions and sample XML.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Form `id` and `version` identify the XForm. Required submission `instanceID` is a universally unique string for that submission. Optional `timeStart` and `timeEnd` are ISO 8601 client timestamps; optional `deprecatedID` can link a revised submission to the original, subject to server handling.
sources.applicability: Useful identity and timestamp fields for ODK-compatible design. A phone-provided time is not independent proof of clock accuracy; the documentation does not claim that it is.

sources.title: Managing Forms in Central — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; page describes versioned Central behavior and historical version boundaries (including Draft UI moved in Central v2025.1).
sources.locator: ‘Forms in ODK Central’, ‘Working with Form Drafts’, ‘Updating Forms to a New Version’, and ‘Accessing Older Form Versions’; web lines 119–170 and 221–261.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the primary Central form lifecycle page; read draft/publish, app-user access, form version and export caveats.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Drafts can be tested before publishing; App Users must separately receive form access. Publishing a new version preserves old submissions, but exports default to the current form definition and may omit removed fields; export can include fields from prior versions. ODK Cloud is linked as managed hosting and Central installation docs are available for self-hosting.
sources.applicability: Relevant to 25 volunteers who may hold older downloaded forms while offline and to the deployment/export comparison. No deployment or permissions were created.

sources.title: Managing Submissions in Central — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; current UI/API behavior is not tied to one specific Central build on the page.
sources.locator: ‘Downloading Submissions as CSVs’, ‘Editing Submissions’, ‘Submission Review States’, and ‘Allowing web form users to work offline’; web lines around 175–200 and 313–330.
sources.observed_operation: Opened page and reviewed export, editing, review, and web-offline conditions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: ZIP export may contain a root CSV, repeat-table CSVs, and `files/` subfolders keyed by submission instance ID. Edited submissions create a new version and set review state to Edited. ODK Web Forms do not support offline completion/submission; Enketo queues offline, but auto-send occurs only while the form remains open in the browser.
sources.applicability: Supports the product comparison and warns against assuming all browser form routes have Collect-like offline/retry behavior.

sources.title: Submission Management API — ODK Docs
sources.version_or_commit: Current Central REST API documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; page marks `deviceId` at API 1.4 and `currentVersion` at Central 2023.2.
sources.locator: Submission identity/versions at lines 119–128; POST create and duplicate-ID response at lines 264–270; `createdAt` server receipt and metadata at lines 175–195 / 443–449; CSV endpoints elsewhere on page.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official API reference and inspected create, identity, server receipt time, and version sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Submission XML is POSTed; this REST create endpoint does not include attachments in that request. An existing `instanceId` produces HTTP 409. Central defines `createdAt` as the time the server received the submission. The original submission `instanceId` identifies the submission overall; individual versions have version metadata/IDs.
sources.applicability: A duplicate ID requires reconciliation; it is not evidence that a second observation should be created. API supports XML submission creation, not a documented native CSV-to-submission import workflow. This limited doc review does not rule out external import tooling.

sources.title: Prevent editing of submissions that failed to send — ODK Collect issue #4589
sources.version_or_commit: Opened 2021-06-02; closed 2021-07-07 by PR #4655; historical issue against Collect.
sources.locator: Issue description and maintainer discussion on delivery limbo; web lines 129–164, 301–365, 426–439.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the public source issue, read reported failure and maintainers’ discussion; followed issue-linked commit/release records separately as S07–S08.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The reported case is a submission accepted by Central when the client does not receive the POST result; editing the failed local item may change XML (such as an end timestamp), so same-ID resubmission with changed XML is rejected. Maintainer discussion identifies submission-failed state and accidental-edit prevention as the narrow fix.
sources.applicability: Bounded historical reconnect/ambiguous-ack example. It does not establish a present defect in current Collect, and it does not address independent duplicate observations or owner merge policy.

sources.title: Collect commit 0bc6cde — CursorLoaderFactory etc. for #4589
sources.version_or_commit: Commit 0bc6cde (abbreviated SHA displayed by GitHub), associated with issue #4589; June 2021 commit activity.
sources.locator: `CursorLoaderFactory` diff filters `STATUS_SUBMISSION_FAILED` from unsent/editable results and adds `FormResubmissionTest`; web lines 128–150, 185–298, 361–406.
sources.observed_operation: Opened primary source-code history and inspected the linked commit diff; code was not downloaded or run.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The code change excludes failed-send records from the unsent/editable selection and includes a test for resubmission after a failed response. It does not lock all finalized forms or prohibit later opt-in versioned correction.
sources.applicability: Evidence for the actual narrow historical fix and its test, not a general exactly-once guarantee.

sources.title: Submit survey results — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living Survey123 documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; no app build displayed on page.
sources.locator: Offline submit / Outbox directions, web lines 11–33.
sources.observed_operation: Opened and read field-app send, offline Outbox, and post-submit editing notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: With no connection, a response can be saved in Outbox, optionally edited before submission, then sent after reconnection. Post-submit editing depends on survey configuration.
sources.applicability: Confirms Survey123 is a usable Android offline candidate; not tested with the charity’s data or settings.

sources.title: Publish a survey — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; defaults and version caveats are stated on page; no app build pinned.
sources.observed_operation: Opened publishing options, sync default, Enterprise offline note, and Sent-folder configuration.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Enable sync is off by default; offline web maps may need extra Enterprise setup. Editing sent surveys is disabled by default. Sent and Inbox together may produce stale records when another user changes a record.
sources.applicability: Deployment/operations tradeoff for a charity already using ArcGIS; test layer configuration and correction workflow.

sources.title: Edit existing survey data — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; global-ID edit behavior from Survey123 3.9; Enterprise attachment limitation before 10.8.1.
sources.locator: ‘Edit an individual response’ and ‘Limitations’; web lines 45–96.
sources.observed_operation: Opened page and reviewed user privilege, attachment edit, and supported-survey limitations.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Owner can edit; submitters need applicable submitter/viewer plus add/update permissions. Attachments are modifiable in individual-response/web-app editing. Nested repeats are unsupported; Enterprise surveys earlier than 10.8.1 with attachment questions are unsupported for this editing path.
sources.applicability: Good correction support with permission/version boundaries; public sign-in-free collection does not remove correction authorization requirements.

sources.title: View your results — ArcGIS Survey123 documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation reviewed 2026-10-10; no ArcGIS product build pinned.
sources.locator: ‘Download results’; web lines 56–66 and related attachment/choice notes later on the page.
sources.observed_operation: Opened data-export formats and table/attachment notes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: CSV, Excel, KML, shapefile, and file geodatabase exports are listed. CSV/Excel store the coded choice name, not display label. Attachment-keyword information may need attention when data is exported and republished.
sources.applicability: Useful GIS-native export alternative, with attachment and coded-value handling to verify in the pilot.

sources.title: Replication introduction — Apache CouchDB 3.5.1 documentation
sources.locator: Replication procedure, changes feed, batches, continuous mode, and checkpoint recovery; web section 2.1.
sources.observed_operation: Opened version-pinned primary documentation for replication behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Replication proceeds by changes-feed comparison; a task may be continuous. Replication checkpoint documents allow restart from where processing stopped, including after a crash. One replication task transfers one direction; bidirectional behavior requires paired tasks.
sources.applicability: A bounded analogy for offline synchronization and restartable transport; not a survey-product deployment recommendation.

sources.title: Replication and conflict model — Apache CouchDB 3.5.1 documentation
sources.locator: Conflict explanation and `_conflicts`/leaf revision examples; section 2.3, web lines around 111–125 and surrounding discussion.
sources.observed_operation: Opened version-pinned primary documentation on revision conflicts.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Conflicting revisions may coexist as leaf branches. CouchDB exposes a winning revision by deterministic rules while retaining losing branches; the application must choose whether to leave, revert, or merge.
sources.applicability: Useful analogy for keeping correction history and making resolution an explicit application decision; do not adopt silent winner selection for field observations.

sources.title: Collecting data using KoboCollect — KoboToolbox documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation; last updated 2026-07-17 per page; application/server build not pinned.
sources.locator: Offline setup and collection, Draft/Ready to send/Sent, and bulk upload; web lines 7-16, 18-47, 49-91.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official KoboToolbox support page and reviewed current KoboCollect offline and form-update behavior.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Forms must first be deployed and downloaded while connected; data can then be collected offline. Depending on project settings, drafts remain editable, finalized records are Ready to send, and auto-send can queue an item until connectivity returns. Data normally stays on device until manually deleted; Delete after send is an optional setting.
sources.applicability: Supports Kobo as a plausible Android field product; form updates require online retrieval, which matters for volunteers returning late with a previous form version.

sources.title: Editing and deleting your data — KoboToolbox documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living documentation; last updated 2026-05-06 per page; application/server build not pinned.
sources.locator: Individual edits, raw data edits, duplicates, delete behavior, and troubleshooting; web lines 7-27, 28-61, 79-106, 121-131.
sources.observed_operation: Opened the official KoboToolbox support page and reviewed correction, identity, undo, and export-version cautions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Post-submit corrections happen in KoboToolbox rather than KoboCollect. Every saved edit changes `_uuid` while `rootUuid` remains the original; web-form edit uses the latest form and may recalculate or remove fields; raw edits are not undoable and the docs recommend an external edit log. Submission deletion is permanent.
sources.applicability: A useful alternative for comparison, but current documented correction behavior needs explicit external history and careful schema/version testing for this pilot.
